definition: [ מָהַל ] verb circumcise, weaken (si vera lectio; compare Late Hebrew מָהַל circumcise , Aramaic מְהַל id. ); — only figurative Qal Passive participle סָבְאֵךְ מָהוּל בַּמָּ֑יִם Isa 1:22 thy choice wine weakened with water , so Thes De Che Comm Di Du ; compare vinum castrare , Plin xix. 53: Ba Erkl. d. Jes. Che Hpt (compare Nö ZMG xl.1886, 741 ) compare Late Hebrew מוהל , juice (of fruit, especially olives); Arabic oil, liquid pitch, suppurating matter ; see against this Di . [ מַהֲלָךְ ] see הלך . [ מַהֲלָל ], מַהֲלַלְאֵל see II. הלל . מַהֲלֻמוֺת see הלם . [ מַהֲמֹרָה ], מַהֲמֹרוֺת see המר . [ מַהְפֵּכָה ], מַהְפֶּ֫כֶת see הפך .
